title: Tamil Nadu merchandise exports, customs-origin, official state export tracker
method_note: Fiscal-year sums of the monthly USD values published on the Government of Tamil Nadu single-window portal export tracker. Customs origin is a proxy for production origin. Official vintages of the state export series disagree on levels: the 2014 Export Strategy itself states USD 35.90 billion for 2013-14, while later DGCIS-derived compilations report about USD 26.9 billion for the same year. Readings are shown without pass/fail verdicts.
